provision.quote: Challenge is to the show cause notice dated 30/5/2025 issued under Section 74 of The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

financial_years.quote: The notice issued pertains from April – 2018 to March – 2024

date.quote: Challenge is to the show cause notice dated 30/5/2025

events.quote: Challenge is to the show cause notice dated 30/5/2025 issued under Section 74 of The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

document_contents.quote: The notice issued pertains from April – 2018 to March – 2024, saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

defects_argued.quote: In the light of the statutory scheme, we find that there is no scope for consolidating various financial years/tax period which is attempted by the impugned Show Cause Notices assailed in the Petition.

outcome.quote: The show cause notice dated 30/5/2025 issued by respondent no.2 is quashed and set aside.
